elementDescriptions.general: Full-width text with no screenplay formatting, and indentation you type is kept. For anything that does not fit another element — onscreen records, archival entries, notes.
elementDescriptions.shot: A specific camera shot or angle within the current scene.
elementDescriptions.lyrics: Sung dialogue. Set in italics and kept with the dialogue block.
elementDescriptions.castList: The list of characters appearing in a scene or episode.
elementDescriptions.showEpisode: The show or episode title, centred at the top of a television script.
elementDescriptions.newAct: Marks the start of an act. Television formats start a new page here.
elementDescriptions.endOfAct: Marks the end of an act.
elementDescriptions.parenthetical: A short direction to the actor, in brackets inside a dialogue block.
elementDescriptions.transition: How the film moves to the next scene — CUT TO:, DISSOLVE TO:.
elementDescriptions.sceneHeading: Where and when a scene takes place — INT./EXT., location, time of day.
elementDescriptions.section: An outline heading, from Fountain’s # Section. Structure only: it shows in the navigator but never on the printed page. Use New Act for an act break a reader should see.
elementDescriptions.note: An aside to yourself, kept in the file and left off the printed page.
elementDescriptions.avBlock: A two-column Audio/Video body — Video on the left, Audio on the right, one row per shot. Used for commercials, corporate video and documentary.
